title: Mara and the Hollow
author: Rafael Okonkwo
blurb: Bram Quintana, a hedge-witch's runaway apprentice, has never left the valley where magic cannot follow. Then the border wards fall on the same night the stars go out — and they are pulled straight into the middle of it. Now they must carry a secret that could reignite an ancient war, and time is already running out.
style: atmospheric and lyrical, with strong sensory detail
